mechanism: Exactly the round06 learning factor: only proven otherwise-feasible pure-rate projection can retain signed target-aligned partial learning. Mixed/amplitude/hard-clip/sector/speed/withdrawal/contraction states freeze error-driven updates and growth; original weight leakage persists.

learningRules.reason1: Only PROJECTED mask and otherwise-feasible target, no hidden hard clip: rho=clip(dot(actualIncrement,targetIncrement)/norm(targetIncrement)^2,0,1), zero denominator gives0; learning=pre-classifier gate*rho.
learningRules.otherReasonBits: 2=hard clip,4=other/mixed cause; learning0, rho0. Contraction/withdrawal always belong to mixed cause.
learningRules.growthAndLeakage: Growth check every20 steps still requires effective learning>=0.5 and count<60. Leakage and weight projection bounds unchanged.
